title: 第21章 变强变强再变强第22章 宗门升级二星宗门
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
“宗门还发放灵石？！”
看着手中储物袋里的灵石，除了对灵石价值一无所知的叶青瑶一脸懵懂之外，其他三位弟子全都愣住了。
发灵石的宗门，放眼整个大陆，就从未听说过！
一块下品灵石，黑市价格至少在两千两黄金以上，而且还是有价无市。
尤其是肖岩，他对此的感受最为深刻和直接。
因为整个肖家在云水城六个坊市一年辛苦经营下来的净利润，都未必能够达到一千两黄金。
至于灵石，更是连想都不敢去想！
萧灵汐也是露出了无比惊讶的神色，萧家是大家族，但灵石也属于是稀缺资源，连她都没有分到过一块呢！
“师尊，这么珍贵的东西，弟子怎么敢拿！”诸葛风赶紧拒绝，这可太贵重了！
价值万金以上啊！
这是他一辈子都无法遥望的巨额数目！
即使是灵霄宗，都可以轻松进入，并且足以购买全套的灵霄诀炼气篇！
至于其他宗门，甚至可以购买一颗筑基丹了！
“师尊，我们不能要！”
肖岩与萧灵汐两人也都摇头，这实在太贵重了，根本承受不起！
见三位师兄师姐都这样，叶青瑶也摇了瑶头不敢接受。
见此，苏白微微一笑：“你们知道，天道宗如今最缺的是什么吗？”
四名徒儿皆是疑惑不解。
苏白淡笑着说道：“最缺的，是优秀的弟子！”
“当你们有一天，可以独自闯荡世界，打响天道宗的名气时，才是我天道宗辉煌耀眼之刻！”

“这个世界，敌人不会与你们讲道理，讲道义，唯有拳头，才是真理。”
“所有，你们现在唯一的任务，就是修炼，修炼，再修炼，就是变强，变强，再变强！”
“记住，只有强大的实力，才能保护自己，守护宗门！”
苏白话语严肃认真，一字一句传到了四人耳边。
诸葛风等人心中激动，脸色涨红，拳头握紧，身体忍不住颤抖了起来。
师尊所言不假，只有强大的实力，才能庇护自己，守护宗门！
对诸葛风来说，他需要实力为父母报仇！
对萧灵汐来说，她需要实力摆脱家族与赵宝霄！
对肖岩来说，他需要实力打赢柳嫣然，证明自己不是废物！
对叶青瑶来说，她需要实力去寻找自己的姐姐！
只有强大，他们才能拥有一切！
只有强大，才能保护自己！
只有强大，才能守护宗门！
“弟子谨遵师命！”
几乎同一瞬间，四人异口同声道。
几乎同一瞬间，四位弟子的宗门忠诚度全部飙升到了九十五。
距离一百，皆只有一步之遥了。
“快去修炼吧，更多敌人，就在眼前了。”
苏白拍了拍他们肩膀，嘱咐道。
“弟子告退！”

几人恭敬行礼，转身继续修炼。
山脚下，依然还有不少人围观着，都在等待着灵琅宗与灵霄宗的强者到来。
content_en:
"The sect also distributes spiritual stones?!"
Looking at the spirit stones in the storage bag in their hands, except for Ye Qingyao who had no clue about the value of the spirit stones, the other three disciples were all stunned.
Looking at the whole continent, the sect that produces spiritual stones has never heard of it!
The black market price of a low-grade spiritual stone is at least two thousand taels of gold, and there is still a price but no market.
Especially Xiao Yan, he felt this most deeply and directly.
Because the entire Xiao family's net profit from a year's hard work in the six cities of Yunshui City may not reach one thousand taels of gold.
As for the spiritual stone, I don’t even dare to think about it!
Xiao Lingxi also showed an extremely surprised look. The Xiao family is a big family, but spiritual stones are also a scarce resource, and even she has not received a piece of it!
"Master, how dare this disciple take such a precious thing!" Zhuge Feng quickly refused. This is too precious!
It’s worth more than ten thousand gold!
This is a huge amount that he can't even hope to reach in his lifetime!
Even Lingxiao Sect can easily enter, and it is enough to purchase the complete set of Lingxiao Jue Qi Refining Chapter!
As for other sects, you can even buy a Foundation Building Pill!
"Master, we can't have it!"
Xiao Yan and Xiao Lingxi both shook their heads. This was too expensive and they couldn't afford it!
Seeing that the three senior brothers and sisters were all like this, Ye Qingyao also shook her head and did not dare to accept it.
Seeing this, Su Bai smiled slightly: "Do you know what Tiandao Sect lacks most now?"
The four disciples were all puzzled.
Su Bai smiled lightly and said: "What we lack most are excellent disciples!"
"When one day you can travel the world alone and build the reputation of Tiandao Sect, that will be the glorious moment for Tiandao Sect!"
"In this world, the enemy will not reason with you or talk about morality. Only fists are the truth."
"So, your only mission now is to practice, practice, and practice again, to become stronger, stronger, and stronger again!"
"Remember, only strong strength can protect yourself and the sect!"
Su Bai's words were serious and serious, and each word reached the ears of the four people.
Zhuge Feng and others were excited, their faces flushed, their fists clenched, and their bodies couldn't help but tremble.
What Master said is true, only strong strength can protect yourself and protect your sect!
For Zhuge Feng, he needs the strength to avenge his parents!
For Xiao Lingxi, she needs the strength to get rid of her family and Zhao Baoxiao!
For Xiao Yan, he needs the strength to defeat Liu Yanran and prove that he is not a waste!
For Ye Qingyao, she needs strength to find her sister!
Only by being strong can they have everything!
Only by being strong can you protect yourself!
Only by being strong can we protect our sect!
"Disciple, please obey your master's orders!"
Almost at the same moment, the four people said in unison.
Almost at the same moment, the sect loyalty of all four disciples soared to ninety-five.
One hundred is only one step away.
"Go and practice quickly, more enemies are right in front of you."
Su Bai patted their shoulders and instructed.
"Disciple, resign!"
Several people bowed respectfully and turned around to continue practicing.
At the foot of the mountain, there were still many people watching, waiting for the arrival of powerful men from Linglang Sect and Lingxiao Sect.
